blocks.html: Aimed at reducing inflammation and improving circulation, our Soothing Facial is wonderful for anyone with reactive, sensitive skin. You will receive a gentle, yet effective exfoliation, followed by the application of nourishing serums and moisturizers, all packed with soothing anti-inflammatory and conditioning ingredients. This service includes cool and refreshing facial globes, which stimulate circulation in your face, reduce puffiness, and leave your skin feeling tighter and instantly refreshed.
Our extended Soothing Facial also includes a calming Intensive Recovery Hydrojelly Mask and LED Light Therapy to further soothe sensitized skin.
Pairs well with: lip treatment, eye treatment, decollete treatment, dermaplaning, resurfacers

blocks.html: This is one of our most popular facial treatments!

Dermaplaning is a non-invasive cosmetic procedure that involves manual exfoliation of the epidermis with a sterile surgical blade to remove dead skin cells and vellus hair (peach fuzz) leaving your skin super smooth and glowing. This procedure softens the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles while increasing the absorption of topical products. Dermaplaning creates the perfect canvas for make-up application which makes it a go-to procedure before special events.
This 75 mins treatment also includes an Intensive Recovery Hydrojelly mask and LED Light therapy.
Pairs well with: eye treatment, lip treatment, decollete treatment.

This includes lifting the cheekbones, contouring the jawline, tightening and lifting the jowls, while softening any fine lines and wrinkles.

blocks.html: Our back facial is designed for those who maintain an active lifestyle, helping to wash away oil and cell build-up caused by sweat. Our Clinical Esthetician will scrub, steam, and extract impurities from your back and shoulders, hydrating and toning the skin for a deep clean and refreshing experience.

blocks.html: Add on any of the following treatments to your targeted facial to get the customized results you need.
This add-on is a restorative and effective remedy for dry, dehydrated lips. The treatment includes  a lip scrub, lip mask and hydrating lip serum to leave skin feeling nourished.

This add-on is designed to target an area of the body that is often forgotten about: the neck & upper chest. As an extension of your facial, this service will apply the same techniques and products to your neck and decollete, which will keep your neck looking young and rejuvenated.

This add-on is a soothing, gentle and hydrating treatment for tired eyes. A combination of targeted eye masks, hydrating serums and a specially designed micro-current device help reduce fine lines and puffiness.

This add-on is a non-invasive cosmetic procedure that involves the manual exfoliation of the epidermis (the outermost layer of your skin) with a sterile surgical blade. As a result, all the dead skin cells and vellus hair (peach fuzz) are removed, leaving your skin smooth and glowy. This procedure is great for those looking to soften the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles and even out the skin’s surface. Due to its smoothing abilities, dermaplaning is an incredible pre-event treatment.
For a deeper more comprehensive form of exfoliation, you can incorporate any of our DermaQuest resurfacing treatments (Lactic Acid, Pumpkin, Mangobrite & C Infusion) into your facial.

This add-on LED Light Therapy utilizes therapeutic wavelengths of light to enhance collagen and elastin production (red light - 630nm), combat the overproduction of acne-causing sebaceous oils, and kill off p.acneus bacteria (blue light - 415nm), reduce redness, and improve overall circulation. Infrared light (830 nm) accelerates the healing process by promoting lymphatic flow. The mode will be selected by the Esthetician based on consultation and the desired course of treatment.
